therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: ERK1 and ERK2 protein kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced tumors, melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, Erdheim-Chester disease, and other RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK mutated tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD), Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLT), and Tumor Objective Response Rate (ORR)

results.effect_size: ORR 0% across all dose levels (95% CI ranges from 0-70.8% to 0-36.9%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in Cmax and AUC observed across dose levels, suggesting target engagement
safety_signals: DLT observed at 800mg QD dose level (2 participants)
Serious adverse events including intestinal obstruction, pyrexia, pneumonia, and gastrointestinal toxicities
results.dose_information: Dose escalation from 25mg BID to 800mg QD; DLT observed at highest dose level (800mg QD)

context.investigator_commentary: Study terminated early due to insufficient number of participants with events
